Title: Ghostfolio technical map for the feature
FunctionalObjective: Understand where everything lives so nothing breaks when building insights
AcceptanceCriteria: Document with real verified paths and recommended planning command

Title: Functional contract of the Portfolio Insights Assistant
FunctionalObjective: Define what insights the feature offers and in what data shape
AgenticDeliverable: Skill ghostfolio-domain-analysis + agente portfolio-domain-agent + datos via MCP
AcceptanceCriteria: Contract with 3-5 descriptive insights traceable to MCP metrics

Title: Portfolio Insights widget in the UI
FunctionalObjective: Let a user see a panel with insights from the demo portfolio
ProductDeliverable: Plan or component of a visible widget with concentration/anomalies
AcceptanceCriteria: Plan with real component path, analogous component, inputs/contract and validation (npm run lint)

Title: Demo Portfolio Health section
FunctionalObjective: A view that summarises the descriptive health of the demo portfolio
ProductDeliverable: Plan or view with simple health/insights visualisation
AcceptanceCriteria: Plan with where the view is mounted, what metrics it shows and where they come from

Title: Explain demo portfolio button
FunctionalObjective: An interaction that requests and displays the demo portfolio summary
ProductDeliverable: Plan or implementation of a button that consumes an endpoint/MCP
AcceptanceCriteria: The displayed text passes the safety review (PASS) and is descriptive

Title: Mocked portfolio insights endpoint
FunctionalObjective: Expose a deterministic demo summary for the frontend to consume
ProductDeliverable: Technical plan for the endpoint (module/controller/service + DTO)
AcceptanceCriteria: Plan with contract in libs/common, route /api/v1, analogous module and validation npm run test:api; no real LLM

Title: Concentration service by account/symbol
FunctionalObjective: Calculate the exposure/concentration of each account as reusable data
ProductDeliverable: Backend service or plan that calculates cost per symbol and quota per account
AcceptanceCriteria: Read-only logic that reproduces the MCP get_symbol_exposure figures

Title: Concentration/exposure rules for the demo portfolio
FunctionalObjective: Define how concentration is measured in a descriptive way
ProductDeliverable: Exposure rules document with real figures from the demo dataset
AcceptanceCriteria: Rules with MCP figures and currency/cost caveat

Title: Anomaly rules on imported data
FunctionalObjective: Define what counts as an anomaly in imported data
ProductDeliverable: Anomaly catalogue with definition and severity
AcceptanceCriteria: Catalogue that explains the 5 types and matches the MCP output

Title: Local read-only MCP for demo data
FunctionalObjective: Give OpenCode a stable tool to query demo data without destructive access
ProductDeliverable: Local MCP server registered in opencode.json with list_demo_accounts
AgenticDeliverable: Agente mcp-builder-agent + skill mcp-server-authoring + config opencode.json
AcceptanceCriteria: check-demo-mcp passes green; OpenCode lists the server tools

Title: Tool get_demo_portfolio_summary
FunctionalObjective: Allow any agent to obtain a deterministic summary of the demo portfolio
ProductDeliverable: MCP tool with totals, holdings and concentration per account
AcceptanceCriteria: Returns 3 accounts, 54 activities and quotas per symbol; smoke test green

Title: Tool detect_demo_anomalies
FunctionalObjective: Deterministically detect simple anomalies in imported data
ProductDeliverable: MCP tool that reports duplicates, high commission, currency, atypical price and oversale
AcceptanceCriteria: Detects the 5 types in the anomalies CSV and ~0 in the clean dataset

Title: Assistant limits guide
FunctionalObjective: Make clear what the feature can and cannot say
AcceptanceCriteria: Checklist of 7 points and PASS/FAIL examples applicable to FE/MCP/INT

Title: Review that a response does not recommend buying/selling
FunctionalObjective: Ensure that no visible text recommends personalised financial actions
ProductDeliverable: PASS/FAIL report with findings and safe rewrite
AcceptanceCriteria: Report with verdict and, if FAIL, a safe rewrite

Title: End-to-end demo happy path
ProductDeliverable: Demonstrable and reproducible path (Portfolio Insights Demo)
AcceptanceCriteria: /workshop-analyze-demo-portfolio runs, outputs summary with MCP figures and passes safety; steps are repeatable

Title: Team handoff
FunctionalObjective: Allow one team to continue another team's work without losing context
AcceptanceCriteria: Handoff with components used, files touched, tests and next step
